scope: Implement PAR-128/7AP.5: prevent generic proxy-cache replay from aliasing class-specific DXF groups, and preserve common-vs-subclass parse meaning for the demonstrated MLEADER/OLE cases.

method.kind: Source-generated ASCII/Binary group sequences and public adapter refusal controls
method.limitations: Generated parser controls exercise ordered group-code sequences through the entity parseCode routes, not an independently authored application file. Generic proxy replay is positively qualified only for LINE; external producer/native proxy semantics remain unqualified. OLE private parse-state changes C++ class layout, requiring downstream rebuilds; no virtual interface changed.
